guidelines.description: Never allow wildcard ('*') resource actions or principals unless absolutely necessary. Policies should be scoped down to the minimum required permissions.
S3 buckets must block public access unconditionally by default. Server-side encryption (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS) must be enabled.
Never commit AWS keys, DB passwords, API tokens, or other sensitive credentials directly in source code or IaC configs. Use Secrets Manager or environment variables.
Avoid opening ports to '0.0.0.0/0' (the entire internet), especially for sensitive ports like 22 (SSH), 3389 (RDP), or database endpoints.
Ensure databases queries use parameterized binding instead of string concatenation to prevent SQL injection. Escape all inputs before executing shell commands.
